लोच् (only —˚) लोचते & C. लोचयति, (only —˚) लोचते &
C. लोचय˚ते
[]
w. आ consider, reflect;
 C. the same, r. cause to
appear or be seen;
 pp. आलोचित (n. also impers.). अन्वा, पर्या, समा &
निस् C. call to mind, imagine, consider, reflect, deliberate.
लोचनगोचर a. within the range of the eye.

लोचनत्रयपथ m. the range of the three eyes
(of Śiva).
लोचनपथ m. path of the eyes, sphere of vision.
लोचनाञ्चल m. corner of the eye.
लोचनानन्द m. delight of the eyes.*
